name: Sansão
notes: Hopper: Mônica's blue plush bunny (pairs with the avatar piece kc-handheld-tmsansao: cream eye whites, long ears). Hops squash and stretch at the sides, never through the face; the ears lag a frame (pressed short on the launch, streaming tall on the landing); every hop rises 4 px at the top (hopper rule). happy-down: arms up and open, then a hug across the belly, eyes closed in arcs. sit-down: one ear flopped (one shape from the head top to a curled tip, hanging clear of the cheek), eyes half-lidded, a row lower. sleep-any: a plush toy asleep sitting up, slumped two rows lower, both ears drooped down its sides, eyes closed in arcs, the nose kept. hop-left is a real leap (the back stretched, front paws reaching, hind legs pushing off). Extra clip: blink-down (1 frame).
